checks.explanation: The premise didn't hold up: the incoming Trump administration froze NEVI funding in February 2025, and even after a court forced funds released, states had obligated only about $1.4B and spent just 2% ($94 million of $4.4B available) as of a January 2026 report, putting the program far behind the 2026-2027 installation pace Buttigieg predicted.
Zohran Mamdani won the November 4, 2025 New York City mayoral election, defeating Andrew Cuomo and Curtis Sliwa.

sources.title: Zohran Mamdani wins New York City mayor's race, NBC News projects
